title: PathoFluor-At: fluorescence hyperspectral imaging of Arabidopsis seedlings challenged with Pseudomonas syringae or flg22 (code, manifests, derived data, manuscript)
description: Reanalysis of a 2016 UW-Madison fluorescence hyperspectral imaging experiment (MacroPhor imager, 488 nm excitation, 500-800 nm emission) on Arabidopsis thaliana seedlings of Col-0, fls2-17, fls2-101, cml24-2 and cml24-4, imaged before and 1-48 h after treatment with a mock solution, flg22 or Pseudomonas syringae, plus an independent November 2016 replicate (405 nm excitation). The archive contains the analysis code, a manifest of every file on the original drive with SHA-256 checksums, the 2016 hand-drawn ROI spectra, derived per-ROI and per-seedling tables, statistics, figures, and a LaTeX manuscript and slide deck. Raw image cubes are deposited separately (see related identifiers).
